success_definition.accurate: rotation error < 5 deg and relative translation error < 10%

implementations.LoP4P: RPnP on four-point samples plus in-loop alpha=2 soft-weighted GN local refinement, 12 iterations
implementations.RPnP++: rpnp_pp.solve with current C++ implementation, finalize=True and ransac_p=0.7
